summary: Iteration 15 testing: i18n FR/EN, Haiti country addition, activation gating. All 9 backend tests PASSED. Frontend: language modal, language switch, FABs for activated admin all working correctly.

issues: CommunityPopup overlay covers settings cards for ~3-7 seconds after navigation; it does intercept clicks until auto-dismiss. Real users may experience the same friction — consider closing on first user interaction or showing it only on dashboard. Not blocking but UX-noise on settings page.

critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx (line 55): Direct use of window.alert() in language switch success — works on Web but throws on native (Expo iOS/Android). Should use Alert.alert() with platform check or always use Alert.alert for cross-platform consistency.

settings.tsx (line 53): The PUT /api/auth/language failure is silently swallowed (try/catch with empty handler). On network failure user thinks switch succeeded but DB is unchanged. Recommend surfacing an Alert on error.

i18n/index.tsx: I18nProvider does not pull initial language from user.preferred_language at boot — relies on AsyncStorage + settings page useEffect. On first login on a new device the in-DB preference won't apply until user opens Settings. Consider syncing in useAuth or root provider after /auth/me.
